title: Schedule Report Delivery in Reports
description: Complete the schedule report delivery workflow in the Reports module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with general access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Reports module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for schedule report delivery are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Reports module from the main navigation.
Locate the schedule report delivery entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for schedule report delivery.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Schedule Report Delivery completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Reports views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during schedule report delivery.
Permission constraints prevent completion of schedule report delivery.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun schedule report delivery.
Confirm role permissions for general and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun schedule report delivery?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm schedule report delivery is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
